Evidence for synthesis: b/queue-steer-space-bunny.json calls[12] (busyAfterSteerAdmissionhistory) shows queued/steer admissions absent from native history until delivery; calls[15] orders users by delivery (1f3aa3, c229cc before 26fa45); cancelled 56e942 absent. Core reducer hydrate (session_reducer.dart:865-892) keeps admissions missing from history and requests refetch admissionMissingFromHistory; Core observed_a.dart:208-240 materializes UserInput at enqueue (pending/accepted). Batch1: all 4 materialize at enqueue; cancel->DeliveryState.cancelled (Codex wants Core ItemRemoved); Claude adds ResyncRequired on reordering delivery.

Tentative synthesis (pending Space): hybrid by delivery mode per v2-plan §5.5 — steer user enqueued -> UserInput(accepted, pending status) + context marker + pending; queue user/synthetic and steer synthetic -> pending only; queue->steer delivery.changed materializes UserInput; delivered -> resident UserInput delivered/completed in place or first materialization from pending text (Notice for synthetic); cancelled queued -> pending removal only (matches reference retract and history omission); cancelled resident steer UserInput -> DeliveryState.cancelled (unobserved). No Core change; rejects Codex ItemRemoved and Claude reorder resync as unnecessary. Evidence: all 7 observed cancels are queue/user (+1 unknown in service-restart); late-delivered queue items are exactly the reordered ones.

ART-EXECUTION-HANDOFF (Ready, 9 plans; Longcat/Step handshakes timed out, retry pending). API projectOpenCodeInboxEvent(value,current,{sourceVersion,position,receivedAt}) -> unmodifiable List: item upserts first, then PendingInputChanged only when the level-set changes. IDs: user [storageKey,inbox,'user',0], notice [..,'notice',0], context marker [..,'unknown',['context','user-context-manifest',0]] identical to history; PendingInput.id = timeline id; undecodable pending entries preserved. enqueued: steer user -> UserInput(status pending, delivery accepted, live generation incl. enqueue evt id) + context manifest (counts, files mime/sourceKind) + pending; queue user and any synthetic -> pending only (v2-plan 5.5 chips); compaction/move -> validated, []; resident delivered/notice -> no timeline change. delivery.changed: needs pending entry; updates pending; user queue->steer without resident materializes UserInput(accepted) from pending text; resident undelivered UserInput re-upserted accepted/queued. delivered: resident UserInput -> delivered/completed same generation; none resident -> first materialization (UserInput delivered or Notice continuation, completed, generation incl. delivered evt id) from pending text; nothing known -> []. cancelled: resident undelivered UserInput -> delivery cancelled (status completed); remove pending; else pending removal or []. Provenance extra: nativeCreated (event created; delivered time equals history time.created), nativeDurableVersion 1, nativeInboxId, inboxItemType?, nativeDelivery?. Never read metadata/location/base64/names/uri/mention text/description/move fields. Failures malformed/unsupportedVersion/limitExceeded/itemKindMismatch/unsupportedValue; text 256KiB, ids 4KiB. Rejected: Core ItemRemoved (Codex x2) and reorder ResyncRequired (Claude) as unnecessary under hybrid. Tests: inbox_test_data, inbox_projection_test, inbox_replay_test (B-E history user parity incl. order of delivered users vs history in queue-steer captures, privacy E attachment).
